## Summary

Describe the user or system outcome.

## Change type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation/tooling
- [ ] Security or production hardening

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] I manually tested the affected flow
- [ ] Database migration reviewed, or no database change
- [ ] `.env.example` and documentation updated, or not required
- [ ] No secrets, candidate data, recordings, or local environment files included

## Screenshots or API examples

Add evidence when the UI or API contract changes.

## Risks and rollback

Describe deployment risk, data migration impact, and how to revert safely.
